confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge projected to July 2026; no live prices or listings were checked. Restaurant and budget-room anchors are more reliable than alcohol and 3-star hotel rates, which move with excise rules and tourist demand. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer price (about 2.7x and 2.8x) because direct knowledge is weak. Local-currency examples assume about 300 LKR per USD and roughly include typical service and tax. The FX value came from web-search text citing the RBA exchange-rates table; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional South Asian tourist-city basis from general knowledge of local price levels. Alcohol and 3-star hotel tiers are set above regional norms to reflect Sri Lankan excise duties and tourist demand. No specific comparable city was used as a direct benchmark.
